violations.text: The hand-washing sink behind the deli counter was blocked by supplies, and equipment. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Supplies were during time of inspection Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026

Dessert items packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Establishment is to label pre-packaged dessert items. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026

The facility is lacking a mop sink. At least one mop sink or one curbed cleaning facility equipped with a floor drain must be provided and conveniently located for the cleaning of mops or similar wet floor cleaning tools and for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid waste. Establishment is to install a mop sink. New Violation. Correct By: 09/12/2026
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. Establishment is to install a self closing device on the toilet room. New Violation. Correct By: 09/12/2026
The area behind the deli area has an accumulation of products/boxes/equipment. Establishment is to organize area behind deli. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026

Logs of deli meat were observed not marked with the date of opening. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Food items were marked with dates during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/14/2025

Various dessert items repackaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/14/2025

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the back of the retail space. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 03/13/2025
